# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of ~150 call snippets is overwhelmingly **internal-operations chatter** — loading/unloading coordination, driver routing to Manali/Andarkuppam, bank transfer follow-ups, Diwali-gift distribution logistics, battery/duty-cancellation disputes, and e-way-bill/government-portal maintenance worries. These were excluded from this knowledge base per instructions.

Genuine **sales-relevant** material (customer enquiries, rate quotes, quantity/order talk, dealer objections, competitor-price friction) is a **minority but real subset** — roughly 35-40 distinct exchanges. Most are short, transactional rate-check calls rather than full consultative sales conversations. The picture that emerges is consistent: Crayon Roofing & Structures is a **manufacturer/distributor of JSW-branded metal roofing sheets plus accessories (screws, welding rods, decking sheets, polycarbonate sheets, puff panels, flashing)** — they explicitly state they do **not fabricate, install, or fix** anything; they are "material supply மட்டும் தான்." Given the volume of ops noise vs. true sales talk, this KB is intentionally concise and tightly grounded in only what was said.

## Products & brand ladder

Based on explicit statements across calls, Crayon sells/distributes these JSW and allied product lines, from premium to economy:

- **JSW Color On Plus** – the flagship line. Available in **all colors**: "sky blue off white grey blue red எல்லாமே இருக்கும்."
